comments.author: anabis
comments.story: Why Invest in Cities? There's Always Another Boise
comments.text: Most people commute by train. We are improving, but the morning commute is something foreigners consider particularly wacky, and not something that they want to repeat everyday. [VIDEO]

comments.author: mcny
comments.story: Who’s Sitting Next to You on the Subway? An R Train in September
comments.why: Shows staff pushing commuters onto crowded Tokyo trains
comments.text: Can you imagine the lawsuits if we were to have staff push people here? [VIDEO] By the way, as bad as things are in New York MTA, I find it much better than the stupidity of the path train (panynj). We have like four routes to manage and we can't do that properly.
